variants.name: narrow-date-index
variants.sql: DROP INDEX idx_summary_period; CREATE INDEX idx_summary_period ON turn_summary(started_at_ms)

method.readTiming: actual queryUsagePage API, rows + COUNT + prepare + snapshot; warm SQLite/OS caches; no UI/worker IPC; each sample averages a batch of at least 12ms (1000-call cap); alternating/reversing and rotating variant order
method.buildTiming: INSERT SELECT transaction/commit with indexes already present; base fixture generation/schema creation excluded; first load separately; repeated refill uses recycled pages
method.writeTiming: actual replaceSessions transaction/commit; checkpoints excluded; no rollup materialization
method.statistics: ANALYZE then main.optimize on every isolated variant after loading
method.storage: checkpointed allocated/live page bytes and dbstat object allocations; pre-write after repeated refill; WAL bytes are logical file lengths, not physical I/O
method.correctness: all full SQL result rows before timings, exact integer/string/null and relative/absolute 1e-9 for averages/cost; same public first page + counts after timing and writes; explicit id mappings preserved in initial load
caveats: sorted INSERT preserves id; rowid B-tree logical key order stays id, while page fill/free-space can differ
all-row cost fallback deliberately uses raw facts; normal aggregates use existing rollups
date-index changes cannot remove all current computed unknown-last sorting
no installed DB or private source logs read or mutated
